arithmeticMismatch: These numbers do not add up, which they always should. Treat this record as incomplete and check the service.
cancelledAtWithCount_one: Called off on {{when}}, which stopped {{count}} command still held by the platform.
cancelledAtWithCount_other: Called off on {{when}}, which stopped {{count}} commands still held by the platform.
chooseGroupFirst: Choose the group to fire at.
choosePartialFirst: Choose what should happen if some devices cannot receive this command.
commandHint: The published commands the reference device accepts. Devices on other profiles are checked separately and refused individually if they disagree.
commandKeyHint: Sent to every targeted device. The platform checks it against each device's own published vocabulary.
commandKeyRequired: Enter the command key to send.
commandsDescription: The per-device commands this batch created, in the order they were admitted. This is the only place that answers where the fleet write is right now.
description: Every command fanned out to many devices at once, newest first.
devicesHint: Pick devices by name. Order matters: a partially-admitted batch admits in the order given.
draftOnlyLabel: Written on the profile but not published, so the platform will not accept them yet:
duplicatesCollapsed_one: {{count}} repeated device was collapsed — a device named twice is still sent to once.
duplicatesCollapsed_other: {{count}} repeated devices were collapsed — a device named twice is still sent to once.
groupHint: The group is resolved to its devices at the moment the batch fires.
groupVersionHint: Pin the frozen version whose members this batch resolves against. Leave unset to follow the active published version. Only a dynamic group has versions.
nameDevicesFirst: Name at least one device to fire at.
newBatchDescription: Send one command to many devices as a single recorded operation.
noRefusals: Every device the target resolved to was accepted.
overCap: {{count, number}} devices is over the {{max, number}} a single batch may name. Remove some, or split the fleet across several batches.
partialLabel: If some devices cannot receive it
partialOffOption: Refuse the whole batch. Nothing is sent and nothing is recorded — no device acts unless every device can.
partialOnOption: Send to the devices that can take it. The rest are recorded as refusals with the reason each was skipped.
partialUnsetHint: There is no default. Choose one before firing — it decides whether this command may reach part of the fleet and not the rest.
pasteHint: Newline- or comma-separated device tokens, kept in the order pasted. This is the only way to name close to the {{max, number}} a batch allows.
payloadFreeformHint: Sent as-is to every targeted device. Leave empty for a command that carries no payload.
payloadStructuredHint: This command declares a structured parameter the typed form cannot fill, so write the payload yourself.
refusalsDescription: {{count, number}} devices were refused and received nothing.
rejectionNothingCreated: Nothing was created — no batch record, no commands, and no device was sent anything. Correct the request above and fire again.
resolvedNone: The target resolved to no devices at all.
resolvedSome_one: The target had resolved to {{count, number}} device when this was refused.
resolvedSome_other: The target had resolved to {{count, number}} devices when this was refused.
resolvedUnknown: No target set was ever established — the refusal came first, so how many devices were involved is unknown. That is not the same as none.
sampleNone: The service reported no individual devices for this code.
sampleTruncated: Showing {{shown, number}} of {{total, number}} refused devices — the list of names is capped, the total is exact.
storedFactsHint: These are stored facts about the moment the batch fired, not live counts. For where its commands are now, see Commands below.
targetKindHint: Name the devices explicitly, or fire at a group and let the platform resolve it.
title: Command Batches
typeAgainstHint: The command form is typed against one device's published vocabulary. It follows the first device you named; change it to type against another.
typeAgainstPlaceholder: No device — write the command key and payload by hand
typedAgainstCaveat: Typed against {{device}}. Other targeted devices may declare a different vocabulary — the platform checks every one of them and refuses individually, so a form that looks right here can still produce refusals.
unconstrainedHint: That device's profile does not restrict what may be sent, so these are suggestions rather than the whole set.
undecidedNothingCreated: The batch could not be decided, so nothing was created and no device was sent anything. The request can simply be tried again.
unreadableAnswer: The platform answered with neither a batch nor a refusal.
unreadableNothingKnown: Whether the batch was created is not known — unlike a failure to reach the platform, this answer says nothing either way. Check the batch list before firing again, so you do not send the fleet a second copy.
vocabularyUnavailable: Could not read that device's published commands, so the command key is free text. The platform checks it either way.
